news.title: Jeddah Municipality Shuts Down Two Unauthorized Food Facilities, Destroys 2.5 Tons of Products
news.og_title: Jeddah Municipality Shuts Down Two Unauthorized Food Facilities, Destroys 2.5 Tons of Products
news.og_desc:
Jeddah, October 22, 2026, SPA -- The Jeddah Municipality conducted an inspection campaign in the eastern part of the governorate, which led to the discovery of two unauthorized facilities used to produce and prepare food products. The authorities destroyed 2.5 tons of food items, shut down both locations, and seized the equipment found on-site.
    The municipality reaffirmed its commitment to continuing inspection campaigns across food and commercial establishments to ensure compliance with established regulations, enhance food safety, curb illicit practices, and safeguard consumers' health and well-being.
    Furthermore, the municipality encouraged citizens and residents to report any municipal violations through the Balady mobile app or by calling 940 to support regulatory efforts and ensure the prompt handling of such reports.
    -- SPA
11:20 Local Time 08:20 GMT
